newsitem.title: USA: Ill. Superconductor cites order build-up.
newsitem.headline: Ill. Superconductor cites order build-up.

text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp said Monday that orders built up in the 1996 fourth quarter, which should boost early 1997 revenues.

"We are pleased to announce this build-up of sales order activity during the fourth quarter, which we expect will be reflected in our early 1997 revenues," Ora Smith, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement.
During the quarter, the company said it received three commercial orders for its SpectrumMaster ultra-high performance radio frequency filter equipment.
Illinois Superconductor makes and markets radio frequency products to improve the quality and capacity of cellular telephone and other wireless telecommunications services.
The orders, from two cellular operators, are worth $425,000 and bring total SpectrumMaster orders for the year to $600,000 for equipment for six U.S. cellular markets.

Separately, the company said all warrants were exercised under a November 21, 1996 call for redemption of its common stock purchase warrants. The warrants were exercised prior to a December 23, 1996 redemption date.
Shares of Illinois Superconductor were trading up 1/4 at 16-3/4.
